mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1.2% signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1.2%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% in the past month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in housing starts (HOUST) above 1,100 thousand units and retail sales (RSAFS) above 480,000 million dollars in the past month signal robust consumer demand that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed thresholds, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 in the past month indicates weakening manufacturing output that reduces corporate profitability and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during late-cycle economic expansion.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.0 and the regime is late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 3.0% in the past month signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 1.5% in the past quarter indicates strong economic expansion that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days during early-cycle expansion.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 exceeds 1.5% and the regime is early-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained employment increase (PAYEMS) above 145,000 thousand persons in the past month signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 145,000, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in FEDFUNDS below 1.5% and CPIAUCSL below 2.5% in the past month signals an accommodative monetary environment with low inflation, reducing risk-free rates and increasing equity valuations for positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL thresholds are met, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
